name: Nested FAQ
description: Two-level FAQ accordion where each topic section expands to reveal its own list of question and answer rows, with numbered headings, animated height transitions and an optional large title.
contents: Optional header with eyebrow label, title and decorative question mark
Numbered topic sections, each with a list of expandable question and answer items
behavior: Clicking a section toggles it open and closed independently of others
Clicking a question toggles its answer with a smooth height animation
Accent color highlights open sections, icons and numbers
editableByProps: All sections, questions and answers, header texts and visibility
Colors, fonts, width and spacing between sections

needsCodeEdit.change: Allow only one section open at a time
Change the animation speed of panels

fixed: Loads Cormorant Garamond and DM Sans from Google Fonts through an @import inside the component
Root has a solid background and fills at least the viewport height
Title text colors for the heading and open sections are fixed light tones
